s: The cat walks in from the side and sniffs the puppy.
The puppy wags and hops around it.
The camera remains steady as they play on the couch.
Soundscape: soft indoor ambience, light scratching of paws on fabric, playful chirps, muffled puppy yaps; no music.
The lighting is soft and warm, maintaining a high-quality, realistic look throughout the clip.
The background shows the dark closet with shelves and a bag.
The scene begins with a close-up of an old letter on a table.
The camera slowly pans up to reveal an old man.
He reaches for the letter, picks it up and begins to read it.
Finally he looks up from the letter with a gentle smile.
The camera pans up as the kite catches a breeze and soars high.
The camera follows the cat as it walks.
He sweeps for several seconds, then stops.
He leans back in his chair and stares at the wall for a while.
The man puts on a formal suit, takes a broom and begins sweeping the floor.
He gets up, laughs and says «Ну и денёк».
A man stands by the rails.
The train derails.
The style is gritty.
The atmosphere is tense.
The camera is handheld.
Sound: wind.
A visible crack runs across the wall as the building shakes.
Colorful fireworks burst over the river one after another.
The video continues from the first frame where the cat sits.
The dog keeps barking at the mailman for some time.
Rain falls steadily outside the window.
Quality: 4K, cinematic.
The camera zooms in on her face as she starts to cry.
Затем он открывает дверь и выходит на улицу.
